method: Emotion is inferred conservatively from English subtitle wording and limited adjacent context. Delivery mode is copied from locked speaker_type only. Pause labels describe punctuation/timing opportunities, not confirmed performed pauses.
limitations: No audio/video analysis has been performed.
No whisper/shout/cry/laugh, vocal intensity, breath, pitch, timbre, accent, or pace is inferred.
A gap is not proof of a performed pause or breath.
Emotion labels are provisional text-context hypotheses; unmarked means no strong textual signal.
voice_identity_rule: Vivienne C001 remains one voice identity across dialogue, narration, and inner monologue; delivery_function does not create a separate speaker.
